variants.headline: Looking back: building job cancelled part-way
variants.sub: The client has abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, had been cancelled part-way.

The gazette records cancellation during the work, rather than the completion of the building. The client's abandonment of the plan is the event established here. An administrative account should preserve the distinction between ending the undertaking and announcing any subsequent arrangements for the work or commitments already made.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} should be assessed against the part-way cancellation. This paper records the abandoned plan without treating it as proof of a particular financial settlement or a subsequent use for the unfinished work.

variants.headline: Looking back: client abandons the construction plan
variants.sub: Construction of {project} by {builder} has been cancelled before completion.
variants.body:
Looking back to our earlier coverage, this was the news: The client had abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building.

The gazette records cancellation during the work, rather than the completion of the building. The client's abandonment of the plan is the event established here. An administrative account should preserve the distinction between ending the undertaking and announcing any subsequent arrangements for the work or commitments already made.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The stewardship of {target} should be assessed against the part-way cancellation. This paper records the abandoned plan without treating it as proof of a particular financial settlement or a subsequent use for the unfinished work.

variants.headline: Looking back: unfinished work meets a cancelled project
variants.sub: The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, has been cancelled part-way.
variants.body:

An administrative account should preserve the distinction between ending the undertaking and announcing any subsequent arrangements for the work or commitments already made.

Changes since then deserve examination against the original record. The need to distinguish an established event from its associated hopes and fears remains.
